name: MKX 1 Gram 510 Thread Carts *LIMITED EDITION* - Blueberry Colbbler (Indica)
description:
Blueberry Cobbler (I) – 2025 Winter Collection
Sweet, cinnamon-kissed Blueberry Cobbler delivers cozy, comforting vibes in every puff. One of the 5 limited strains in the 2025 Winter Collection, this indica-forward vape blends notes of vanilla and berry for the ultimate relaxing experience.

The #1 selling vape cartridge on the market, MKX Carts deliver an activated, award-winning THC oil with the highest THC level possible and sensational flavor. Our strain library is constantly adapting to introduce exciting new terpenes and flavors.
